arxiv-2203-00247.title: Band structures under non-Hermitian periodic potentials: Connecting nearly-free and bi-orthogonal tight-binding models
arxiv-2203-00247.creator: Ken Mochizuki, Tomoki Ozawa
arxiv-2203-00247.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ken Mochizuki, Tomoki Ozawa. We explore band structures of one-dimensional open systems described by periodic non-Hermitian operators, based on continuum models and tight-binding models. We show that imaginary scalar potentials do not open band gaps but instead lead to the formation of exceptional points as long as the strength of the potential does not exceed a threshold value, which is contrast to closed systems where real potentials open a gap with infinitesimally small strength.

arxiv-2501-10214.title: Temporal Graph MLP Mixer for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
arxiv-2501-10214.creator: Muhammad Bilal, Luis Carretero López
arxiv-2501-10214.description: Abstract Spatiotemporal forecasting is critical in applications such as traffic prediction, climate modeling, and environmental monitoring. However, the prevalence of missing data in real-world sensor networks significantly complicates this task. In this paper, we introduce the Temporal Graph MLP-Mixer (T-GMM), a novel architecture designed to address these challenges.

arxiv-2506-19315.title: JCAPT: A Joint Modeling Approach for CAPT
arxiv-2506-19315.creator: Tzu-Hsuan, Yue-Yang, Berlin
arxiv-2506-19315.description: Abstract Effective pronunciation feedback is critical in second language (L2) learning, for which computer-assisted pronunciation training (CAPT) systems often encompass two key tasks: automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) and mispronunciation detection and diagnosis (MDD). Recent work has shown that joint modeling of these two tasks can yield mutual benefits.

arxiv-2512-19301.description: Abstract Context. Core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe) are expected to produce intense bursts of neutrinos preceding the emergence of their electromagnetic counterparts. The prompt detection of such neutrino signals offers a unique opportunity to trigger early follow-up observations in the electromagnetic domain, enabling direct studies of the explosion mechanisms and progenitor properties. Aims.

arxiv-2601-06830.title: Constrained Density Estimation using Optimal Transport
arxiv-2601-06830.creator: Yinan Hu, Esteban G. Tabak
arxiv-2601-06830.description: Abstract A novel framework for density estimation under expectation constraints is proposed. The framework minimizes the Wasserstein distance between the estimated density and a prior, subject to the constraints that the expected value of a set of functions adopts or exceeds given values. The framework is generalized to include regularization inequalities to mitigate the artifacts in the target measure.

arxiv-2602-11972.title: Splitting schemes for ODEs with goal–oriented error estimation
arxiv-2602-11972.creator: Erik Weyl, Andreas Bartel, Manuel Schaller
arxiv-2602-11972.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Erik Weyl, Andreas Bartel, Manuel Schaller. We present a hybrid a–priori/a–posteriori goal oriented error estimator for a combination of dynamic iteration-based solution of ordinary differential equations discretized by finite elements. Our novel error estimator combines estimates from classical dynamic iteration methods, usually used to enable splitting–based distributed simulation, and from the dual weighted residual method to be able to evaluate and balance both, the dynamic iteration error and the discretization error in desired quantities of interest.

pmc-10575591.description: Pancreatic carcinoma lacks effective therapeutic strategies resulting in poor prognosis. Transcriptional dysregulation due to alterations in KRAS and MYC affects initiation, development, and survival of this tumor type. Using patient-derived xenografts of KRAS- and MYC-driven pancreatic carcinoma, we show that coinhibition of topoisomerase 1 (TOP1) and bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) synergistically induces tumor regression by targeting promoter pause release.

pmc-12528384.creator: Jie Gao, Sheng Ye
pmc-12528384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Taking Chongqing city as an example, this study utilized AutoNavi POI data, noise complaint records, and field monitoring data to reveal the spatial distribution patterns and residents’ perceptions of noise pollution from music facilities.

pmc-12966232.title: Evolution of outcomes in autologous stem cell transplantation for hodgkin lymphoma over 2 decades at King Hussein cancer center
pmc-12966232.creator: Zaid Abdel Rahman, Abeer Yaseen, Anas Zayed, Lina Alkhdour, Mona Ribie, Albatol Alamoush, Fareed Barakat, Mohammad Alrawashdeh, Alaa Abu Fara, Khalid Halahleh, Omar Shahin, Akram Al-Ibraheem, Mohammad Ma’koseh
pmc-12966232.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (auto-HCT) remains a cornerstone in relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma (HL), especially where access to novel agents is limited. We evaluated trends in outcomes after auto-HCT at King Hussein Cancer Center (KHCC) over two decades. We retrospectively analyzed adult HL patients who underwent auto-HCT between 2003 and 2020, divided into two eras: group A (2003–2015) and group B (2016–2020). Survival was estimated by Kaplan–Meier and compared by log-rank; prognostic factors were assessed with Cox regression.

pmc-13021161.title: A systematic review of shear bond strength of sixth- and fourth-generation adhesives in primary teeth
pmc-13021161.creator: Maryam Hajiahmadi, Najmeh Akhlaghi, Hamid Mosleh, Ehsan Samani, Sheida Bagheri, Zohreh Salehi
pmc-13021161.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:The use of tooth-colored restorations, particularly composite resins, in the treatment of primary teeth has become increasingly common. The durability and clinical success of these restorations largely depend on the adhesive system and its application protocol. Therefore, this study aimed to systematically review the literature comparing the shear bond strength of sixth-generation self-etch adhesives with that of fourth-generation etch-and-rinse adhesives in primary teeth.Materials and Methods:A comprehensive search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Cochrane databases using relevant keywords.

pmc-13145227.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2300 IMPROVING ECG DOCUMENTATION FOR ATRIAL FIBRILLATION DETECTION IN ACUTE STROKE ADMISSIONS: A RE-AUDIT
pmc-13145227.creator: Muhtasim Fuad, Haris Mohammad, Sadaf Alvi, Shrina Patel, Amrita Badanahatti, Narayanamoorthi Saravanan, Saad Abbas
pmc-13145227.description: Background and aimsAtrial fibrillation (AF) is a major modifiable risk factor for ischaemic stroke yet remains under-detected in acute stroke admissions. National guidelines recommend routine ECG monitoring to facilitate early AF detection and timely initiation of secondary prevention. A 2024 audit at Fairfield General Hospital identified suboptimal ECG documentation. This re-audit evaluated whether compliance improved following audit feedback alone.
